scope.applies_to: All demo-copy changes on Elementor layouts, homepages, JetEngine/Elementor presentation templates and WPML counterparts
scope.not_equivalent_to: Global WordPress/Elementor editor hook; explicit, governed content-only workflow validator

source_of_truth: Versioned Elementor template documents and native widget design; not the text seed or a previous chat transformation

allowed: Existing heading.title and other approved existing widget text fields
Existing text-editor.editor text content without changing its HTML tags or attributes
Existing button.text label with its link/format unchanged
Localization of existing text values inside unchanged widget structures
denied: Converting uael-image-gallery, nested-tabs, fluent-form-widget, template, jet-listing-grid, shortcode or any widget to another type
Adding/removing containers, sections, widgets, rows, columns, templates or translation homepage sections
Changing element ID, widgetType, elType, node identity, child order, position, or hierarchy
Changing layout, spacing, margin, padding, color, typography, breakpoints, CSS, animations, responsive settings or page settings
Changing nested tab/gallery/form source IDs, shortcode, post listings, dynamic tags or provider account/mapping
Replacing visual widgets with text/buttons as a shortcut for data-source neutralization
Modifying existing editor HTML structure or attributes rather than its text nodes
Inserting fake customer reviews, real company-owned marketing facts or outbound integrations as placeholder content

enforcement.input_contract: Before and after actual Elementor _elementor_data JSON arrays of the same source document
enforcement.execution_mode: Verify before any write; if validation fails, abort and do not touch original document; after write verify readback, on error roll back with user-authorized procedure
enforcement.note: This validator is mandatory for future governed automated Demo placeholder edits when executed through the approved workflow. The PR does NOT yet install a WordPress-wide runtime save hook; intentional design changes require a separately approved workflow.

verified_repair.source: Original Woo Lab database archive from 2026-10-29; source-specific element JSON only
open_risks: Fluent Forms subscription form 2 is published after restoring its original widget; submission/notification policies require separate review
Review tabs and archive media source isolation still needs verified company-specific data
No runtime enforcement of this policy on manual WordPress/Elementor editing until a reviewed deployable hook is implemented
